description:
Install any app on Samsung Tizen devices — TVs, projectors and smart monitors

Cross-platform desktop installer that side-loads any app onto Samsung Smart TVs, projectors and smart monitors running Tizen OS — Jellyfin, Moonlight, Moonfin, Litefin and a community catalog, or your own WGT package. Handles device discovery, Tizen certificates and installation. Successor to Jellyfin2Samsung.Jellyfin2Samsung.
📦 v2.7.7 — 2026-08-21
Everything from the v2.7.7 beta cycle, promoted to stable.
✨ New
- App icons in the Installed-apps list (both heads). Installed apps now show their real Samsung Store icon, with a colourful lettered fallback for sideloaded/unknown apps. Thanks to @eduardomozart. (#555)
- Run / Stop apps remotely from the Installed-apps list (both heads), plus a desktop debug tunnel that port-forwards the app and opens chrome://inspect/edge://inspect for you — no command line. Thanks to @eduardomozart. (#554)
- Mobile certificate picker — Automatic / Public / Partner. The phone app now lets you choose the signing certificate like the desktop does; after importing a backup it defaults to the imported certificate. (#558)
- Reorder TVApp channels (↑ ↓) on mobile, matching the desktop editor. (#553)
🐛 Fixes
- TVApp streams no longer black-screen when installed from Android. A trimming bug in the released APK broke the injected channel list; both heads now build it trim-safe (and a stray $ in a stream URL can no longer corrupt it). (#553, #557)
- Tidier mobile Settings. The page no longer lists "Certificate" twice, and every section is now a collapsible header you tap to expand instead of one long scroll. (#559)
- More of the app is now translatable. A batch of UI strings that were hard-coded in English (installed-apps controls, settings labels, dialogs, watermarks) are now in the translation catalog, so they appear in your language instead of always in English. Translation is consolidated on Crowdin, and a new CI check keeps the base file 1:1 with the code so strings can't silently go untranslatable again. (#560, #561)
- More reliable installs on older/slower TVs. Reading the TV's DUID is now retried instead of giving up on the first stalled or empty reply — the cause of intermittent "Could not read a valid TV DUID" failures on 2016-era Tizen sets. Also fixes a mobile crash when a download was torn down early. (#562)
- App icons no longer depend on a third-party host. The Installed-apps icon list is now served from our own repo (with the previous source kept as a fallback) and times out quickly, so a DNS/network hiccup falls back to lettered avatars instead of hanging. (#563)
- Apps that need a Partner certificate now install instead of being refused by the TV. A package that declares a Partner-level privilege — such as Overscan's Samsung DRM-info privilege — was still signed with a Public certificate, so the TV rejected it with MISMATCHED_PRIVILEGE_LEVEL. Those privileges are now recognised on both heads, and if you don't have a Partner certificate yet the Partner-signing switch is turned on for you and one is created automatically (you can switch it back off in Settings). (#564, Apps2Samsung/Overscan#13)
> ℹ️ The debug tunnel (#554) needs the updated tizen-sdb (with port forwarding); it degrades gracefully if an older SDB binary is present.
